character.locked_description: Tara is an 8-year-old South Asian girl with a small, compact build and warm brown skin. Her dark hair is tied into two short bunches on either side of her round face. She wears a bright lilac raincoat, hex code #B39DDB, fully zipped up over her clothes, paired with dark slate #37474F shorts. On her back rests a small backpack with tightly pulled straps. Her legs feature brightly striped socks tucked into sturdy hiking boots. In her hands, she holds a small wooden weather-house toy featuring tiny carved figures on a sliding track. At rest, she stands with a rigid, upright posture, her hands firmly gripping the straps of her backpack.
